title: What Chris called Sheik
summary: Chris called Sheik by name or kidded him, never Gray-Eye George; Kelly describes his father as serious and broad-minded.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape

blocks.x: Do you remember what Chris called him? Did he call him by his name, or...?
Well, I don't know too much about him, but I mean...
Did he call him George, or did he call him George?
You know what Willie Parker called Sheik? What? Gray-Eye George. Yeah. You know?

Yeah. My daddy wasn't that type of guy. He wouldn't call him the gray-eyed guy, but I mean, he would mostly call him Sheik, or, you know, kid him in some other way, but he just, you know... I think my guy, my old man was a guy for a more broad-minded type of guy. Yeah. He was just on a serious base, you know, just like I am, you know, a serious type of guy, you know. He would say what he'd feel, but, you know, he wouldn't drag it to no extent. Uh-huh.
He was more of a serious base.
